scalar_types.interpretation_id: stable opaque identifier for parser, extraction profile, and schema interpretation; independent of source path and wall time
scalar_types.record_id: snapshot-scoped identifier; never used to join a pawn or event across saves
scalar_types.pawn_id: validated saved pawn ID, with conservative prefix normalization recorded separately; null only for a candidate lacking a trustworthy ID
scalar_types.evidence_id: lowercase 64-character SHA-256 of canonical JSON for a lossless parsed raw node
scalar_types.source_ref: lowercase 64-character SHA-256 of canonical JSON array [snapshot_id, interpretation_id, canonical_xml_path]
scalar_types.canonical_xml_path: /root[1]/child[1]/repeated[2], one-based sibling occurrence indices for each expanded XML tag name

profile.game_version: observed raw game version or null

campaign_key.identity_rule: Hash only all six validated normalized claim.value fields in the listed order. If any field is missing, unsupported, invalid, or ambiguous, classify review-needed. Never hash raw values, source refs, paths, filenames, timestamps, or descriptive labels.

clocks.ticksAbs_rule: Only when ticksGame and gameStartAbsTick are validated integers: ticksAbs = ticksGame + gameStartAbsTick, status derived; otherwise value null with an explicit non-observed status.

claim.field: Stable domain-local semantic path. Repeated/optional array occurrences include an explicit saved key or bracketed one-based occurrence index; no silent collapse of equal siblings.
claim.value: Normalized semantic JSON scalar or structured value. Unresolved ambiguity may hold explicitly labeled alternatives but never an arbitrary winner; absent or invalid values are null.
claim.raw_value: Exact parsed source value, including whitespace when material, or null when no raw field exists
claim.status: one field_status_vocabulary value; absent differs from an explicit empty collection and explicit-null
claim.unit: documented unit, for example ticks or count, or null
claim.code: raw definition/code when known, or null; never substitute an invented display label
claim.display_label: saved or independently validated label, or null
claim.normalization_rule: stable rule identifier or null; derived claims identify their premise fields
claim.time_observation: null for non-time fields; otherwise the shared time_observation object, including birth, ability-use, growth/vat/cryosleep and other time-bearing semantic claims
claim.evidence_id: content ID for the exact supporting field or inspected containing node; required for every semantic claim, including an anchored observed absence
claim.source_ref: exact source occurrence ID paired with evidence_id; required for every semantic claim
claim.validation: An absent claim requires evidence of an inspected containing node and must never be a fabricated default empty value. Unsupported or unexamined areas appear in coverage, not as unsourced claims. A derived claim carries premise_refs, each containing both IDs.

time_observation.raw_value: exact raw source scalar or null
time_observation.raw_field: exact saved field path relative to its containing record, not a guessed semantic label
time_observation.clock: one clock_vocabulary value, assigned only from a validated field definition
time_observation.normalized_game_tick: integer game-relative tick or null when unknown, invalid, a duration, or a wall clock
time_observation.normalization_rule: stable validated rule identifier, or null when semantics are unverified
time_observation.status: one time_status_vocabulary value; unknown values never sort as zero
time_observation.source_ref: exact supporting occurrence ID paired with evidence_id

pawns.holder_chain: ordered outermost-to-innermost holder objects {kind,saved_id,source_path,evidence_id,source_ref}; never flatten nested ownership into a single scope string
pawns.aliases: observed name or title claims with their own evidence and snapshot provenance; no latest-name overwrite
pawns.domain_shape: {status,claims:[claim,...],links:[link,...]}; every required domain key exists with explicit coverage status, including absent and unsupported
pawns.identity_status_rule: Identity and status_and_interaction explicitly represent faction, guest, prisoner, slave, title and interaction settings with observed/absent/unsupported status; they are not relegated to unknown fields. Roles includes formal role and office claims; ideology and royalty have their own supported claims/coverage.
pawns.link_shape: {kind,target_id,status,evidence_id,source_ref}; parent direction, relationship role, and unresolved reference status remain explicit
pawns.evidence_refs: list of {evidence_id,source_ref} for the materialized pawn body or reference-only occurrence

events.saved_event_id: kind and validated class namespace plus saved ID where namespaces can collide, for example tale:<validatedTaleClass>:Tale_1, archive:<validatedClassNamespace>:<rawID>, play_log:<validatedLogClass>:<rawID>; null when no stable saved ID is supported. An unresolved class collision remains separate, not silently deduplicated.
events.raw_saved_id: exact saved ID text or null; not a guessed integer extracted from narrative text
events.participants: list of {pawn_id,role,status,evidence_id,source_ref}; unsupported actor/victim semantics remain unknown rather than inferred from names or substring matches
events.occurrence: shared time_observation object; null only when no occurrence field exists, in which case no dated recorded_event is asserted
events.claims: all supported event-specific claims, retaining payload variants and raw IDs
events.archive_rule: Archive entries are read from /savegame/game/history/archive/archivables/li with uppercase ID fields when validated. Active letterStack Letter_ references are reference-only unless the exact class inheritance and body semantics are verified; broad integer or name matches do not materialize letters. Preserve unresolved raw-ID namespace collisions.
events.time_rule: Do not normalize an archive time field or infer an event occurrence until its game-method semantics have been verified. Preserve raw_value/raw_field and set clock/status unknown otherwise.

context.collection_rule: Each list holds shared snapshot-level entities once, each as {id,kind,claims,links,evidence_refs}. Related people carry concise identity/status, without recursive biographies. Lists can be empty only when explicitly observed empty; missing extraction is represented in coverage.
context.reference_rule: Resolve exact saved IDs within the snapshot first. Cross-save aliases may be added by the catalog only with their source/time and fallback label.

evidence.node_shape: {tag,attributes:[[name,value],...],text,children:[{node,tail},...]}; attributes and child/tail order preserved exactly, including repeated children and mixed text
evidence.canonical_hash_rule: UTF-8 SHA-256 of deterministic JSON serialization of node with sorted object keys, no extra whitespace and unescaped Unicode; ordered arrays remain ordered. Content ID excludes source path and snapshot identity.
evidence.source_ref_hash_rule: UTF-8 SHA-256 of deterministic JSON serialization of [snapshot_id,interpretation_id,path]; a repeated content node at another path has the same evidence_id but a distinct source_ref.
evidence.retrieval_rule: Catalog persists the lossless node and every occurrence. Retrieval of a generation-bound evidence ID reconstructs node, path, origin snapshot and rule without reopening original saves.

coverage.domains: map from every required pawn domain and event/context domain to {status,observed_count,unknown_count}; no unexamined area is called complete
coverage.unknown_fields: list of {path,structural_kind,serialized_bytes,evidence_id,source_ref}; raw-only means no invented semantic claim
coverage.limits: effective source-size, XML-depth, logical-record, retained-working-value and deadline limits, with explicit failure rather than truncated success

diagnostics.item_shape: {code,severity,message,path,evidence_id,source_ref,details}; missing evidence IDs allowed only when no source occurrence exists

catalog_and_response_factoring.namespace_rule: Registry stores a stable namespace UUID; generation/catalog ID is SHA-256 of canonical logical manifest and interpretation versions, including source hashes/outcomes and collection policy, excluding indexed-at/check wall times and database row order.
catalog_and_response_factoring.fact_dictionary_key: SHA-256 of canonical JSON [domain,field,status,value,unit,code,display_label,normalization_rule]; exclude evidence/provenance IDs, raw_value, and observation time. Preserve every differing raw_value and evidence occurrence in memberships.
catalog_and_response_factoring.memberships: Every materialized snapshot/pawn/record/claim occurrence maps to one fact ID plus raw_value, source_ref, evidence_id and optional-array key/index. This inverse mapping reconstructs all supported semantic observations per snapshot exactly.
catalog_and_response_factoring.runs: Optional compact membership encoding may group repeated facts over explicit snapshot-ID lists or lossless indexes. It must preserve gaps, same-tick alternatives, raw-value/evidence variants and original per-snapshot membership; a run never certifies ancestry.
catalog_and_response_factoring.transport: Logical HistorySnapshot.as_dict() is expanded. SQLite and detail=context JSON may use documented dictionaries and runs only when inverse reconstruction is exact. detail=full expands every retained semantic observation and difference; it may share metadata/evidence references but must not collapse observations into context-style runs. An oversized full result returns RESULT_TOO_LARGE with required bytes, never truncated success. Count actual encoded CLI/MCP response bytes, including any MCP structured/text duplication, against the 16 MiB absolute response ceiling.

chronology_examples.rule: normalized tick exceeds supporting snapshot ticksGame=900
duration is not an event timestamp
no normalization without validated game-method semantics
preserve both state observations and label branch alternatives; do not select a current winner
